story hit 1 high-risk signal(s): Validation Framework. Recommend stricter review standards (>= 3 preMortem scenarios, explicit rollback path). If this story only mentions rather than modifies that area (false positive), run lattice story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-c06a","category":"<category>","reason":"..."}' to fully roll back the auto-elevation (after all auto-elevated riskSignals are dismissed, priority auto-reverts and high-risk gates are lifted).

understanding still has 2 undigested unknowns: The recurrence outcome for the arm comparison — resolved: fraction of a story's findings whose signatureTag was already known from prior stories (a higher value = more un-caught recurrence); compare ON vs OFF.; The significance gate — resolved: a conservative minimum N per arm (e.g. >= a small constant); below it, significant=false with note='insufficient N'. No p-value claim beyond that.
